messages.author: 4a248770402c04bc
messages.subject: List of provided distributions?
parts:
Hello Nimble Users,

I've been looking through the documentation (i.e. user manual) for a list of probability distributions provided by Nimble, and I haven't been able to find one. I suspect that such a list is hiding in plain site somewhere and I've just failed to locate it. Could someone point me in the right direction? Also, if there happens to be a template/tutorial somewhere for converting distributions provided by R that are not yet included in NImble, that would be helpful. I'll probably make one myself if it isn't out there already.

Cheers,
Gregory

messages.author: b252c8306d50e349
messages.subject: Re: List of provided distributions?
parts:
Hi Gregory, 

I think the list you are looking for is in Chapter 5.2.4. of the user manual (https://r-nimble.org/html_manual/cha-writing-models.html#subsec:dists-and-functions). We also have a cheatsheet summarizing the available distributions (page 2 of https://r-nimble.org/cheatsheets/NimbleCheatSheet.pdf)

About writing distributions in nimble there is some explanation in the Chapter 12 of the user manual (https://r-nimble.org/html_manual/cha-user-defined.html) and an example in the website  (https://r-nimble.org/nimbleExamples/zero_inflated_poisson.html) 

Hope this helps! 

Best, 

Sally
